name: Measured text
responsibility: Measures every card, note and label in the faces the core carries; its line breakers serve only the crate's own measures
description: The core shapes every run with archboard-text and breaks it at a width, so a width is never estimated and never asked of the place that draws (ADR 0059, TASK-520.07). Every layout and every painter read the same numbers here. Other crates call two operations (ADR 0091): measure_node(node, &CardWords, Part::{Card, Container, FlowFrame}) and measure_label(text) -> LabelPlates { wide, narrow }. The face mapping, width and the line breakers are crate-private: Painting's scene builders set a run of words through them, and a flow layout reaches the line breakers only through Flow part measures, which also owns title fitting (ADR 0088).
